summary: Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $25 million of common stock under its existing S-3 shelf. The company entered into a Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC. Sales will be made at prevailing market prices, with a 3.0% commission to the agent. No specific price, premium, or close date is stated. This routine shelf takedown does not involve a special situation like an acquisition, buyback, or restructuring.
